Our treatment guide

Advanced dentistry: E-max and zirconia crowns, implants, extractions, dentures, bleaching, tooth-coloured fillings and root canal treatment. Dentofacial aesthetics: braces, aligners and gummy smile correction. Facial aesthetics: permanent makeup, lash lift and tint, mesotherapy, PRP for face and hair, and ear and nose piercing.

View image ↗ Our doctors

Dr. Haris Muhammad Wali-ur-Rahman

Associate Professor and Head, Department of Dental Pharmacology, Bangladesh Dental College. Chief Consultant and Mentor. Smile design and aesthetic restoration; Bioclear Method and injection molding trainer. Profile contact: 01712157578 / 01787667977.

View image ↗ Dental care

Root canal treatment

Root canal care for infected teeth, with assessment of whether single-visit treatment is appropriate and whether a protective crown is needed.

View image ↗ Our doctors

Dr. Sufia Rahaman Brishty

Consultant and Facial Aesthetician. BDS (DU), PGDAC (India), Fellowship in Facial Aesthetic and Aesthetic Medicine (Phoenix, AZ, USA), Masters in Micropigmentation (Phoenix, AZ, USA). Trained in fixed orthodontics and braces. BMDC registration 5508.
